issues.description: The visibility of the REST handler method getAllPersons differs between template and solution: the template declares getAllPersons as public while the solution declares it as private. This is a structural inconsistency in the controller API surface and may confuse students about the expected method visibility for a Spring REST endpoint.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the handler method visibility consistent across template and solution. Prefer declaring controller handler methods as public (e.g., public ResponseEntity<List<Person>> getAllPersons()) in both template and solution to match typical Spring examples and avoid student confusion.
